filename: T2 - Germinoma - suprasellar ventricle , pituitary fossa 002.jpg
description:
There is a mass that is T1 and T2 isointense to brain, which fills the inferior recesses of the third ventricle and extends down along the infundibulum into the pituitary fossa. It demonstrates intermediate, slightly heterogeneous contrast enhancement. The anterior pituitary tissue can be seen as separate from the mass on post-contrast T1.

The pineal gland is a little bulky and demonstrates similar signal intensity and enhancement.

The mass elevates and compresses the optic chiasm and results in increased signal in the optic tracts bilaterally.

No hydrocephalus. No leptomeningeal ependymal enhancement elsewhere.
